summary: This document specifies an IP-based encapsulation for MPLS called MPLS-in-UDP, for situations where UDP encapsulation is preferred to direct use of MPLS, such as to enable UDP-based ECMP or link aggregation.

eli5.summary: MPLS packets can be put inside ordinary UDP packets, like a letter in a regular envelope, so networks that don't understand MPLS can still carry them.
